ja: 青山美智子（あおやま みちこ）
1970年生まれ、愛知県出身。横浜市在住。大学卒業後、シドニーの日系新聞社で記者として勤務。２年間のオーストラリア生活ののち帰国、上京。出版社で雑誌編集者を経て執筆活動に入る。第28回パレットノベル大賞（小学館）佳作受賞。『木曜日にはココアを』（宝島社）で小説家デビュー。同作と２作目『猫のお告げは樹の下で』（宝島社）が未来屋小説大賞入賞。最新刊は『鎌倉うずまき案内所』（宝島社）。
en: Born in 1970 in Aichi Prefecture. Lives in Yokohama. After graduating from university, worked as a reporter for a Japanese newspaper in Sydney. Returned to Japan after two years in Australia and moved to Tokyo. Worked as a magazine editor at a publishing house before turning to writing. Received an honorable mention in the 28th Palette Novel Prize (Shogakukan). Made her debut as a novelist with Thursday Cocoa (Takarajimasha). That book and her second, The Cat's Oracle Beneath the Tree (Takarajimasha), both placed in the Miraiya Novel Prize. Her latest book is The Kamakura Spiral Guide Office (Takarajimasha).
